distribution.narrative: Lin & Smith (2022) describes Cyclorhipidion beaveri from Taiwan, including Taichung City. Smith et al. (2022) independently reports Taiwan and adds Yunnan, with locality evidence from Honghe. Mainland China is therefore promoted to Present, and the reviewed distribution is Yunnan + Taiwan.

host_note: Castanopsis cuspidata var. carlesii is retained from Lin & Smith (2022) at the published infraspecific resolution. Smith et al. (2022) provides no host in the curated record, so no host update is made.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion beaveri Lin & Smith, 2022.

taxonomic_history.name: Cyclorhipidion beaveri
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Lin & Smith (2022) described Cyclorhipidion beaveri as a new species. The existing stable identity VSN_1969 is retained.
